name: localized junctional epidermolysis bullosa, non-Herlitz type
description: Junctional epidermolysis bullosa, localized non-Herlitz-type is a form of non-Herlitz junctional epidermolysis bullosa (JEB-nH) characterized by localized blistering, and dystrophic or absent nails.
